metadata.question: Did Punjab and Haryana have less than 20,000 fires detections in November, 2024, as observed with the VIIRS sensor?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: FIRMS VIIRS data (FIRMS/VIIRS/I-BAND) - Date: November 2024 (2024-11-01 to 2024-11-30) - Location: Punjab and Haryana states in India 2. Masking strategy: - No masking needed - we want to count fire detections - Filter for high confidence fires if needed 3. Logic: - Count total fire detections in the region - Compare with 20,000 threshold - Valid result: A (< 20,000) or B (>= 20,000) - C1: No data available - C2: Not applicable (point data, not raster processing) - C3: Calculation returns null/invalid ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Punjab and Haryana region (approximate boundaries) const punjab = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[73.5, 29.5], [76.8, 29.5], [76.8, 32.5], [73.5, 32.5], [73.5, 29.5]] ]); const haryana = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[74.5, 27.5], [77.5, 27.5], [77.5, 30.5], [74.5, 30.5], [74.5, 27.5]] ]); const region = punjab.union(haryana); // Time period const startDate = '2024-11-01'; const endDate = '2024-11-30'; // Load VIIRS fire data const fires = ee.FeatureCollection('FIRMS') .filter(ee.Filter.date(startDate, endDate)) .filterBounds(region); const fireCount = fires.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Date Range: ${startDate} to ${endDate}`); console.log(`Region: Punjab and Haryana, India`); console.log(`Total VIIRS Fire Detections: ${fireCount}`); console.log(`Threshold: 20,000 fires`); if (fireCount === 0) { console.log('No fire data found for the period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } if (fireCount < 20000) { console.log('Fire count is LESS than 20,000'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Fire count is 20,000 or MORE'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
